+template<class T> class DeviceBuffer {
+public:
+    T* data = nullptr;
+    explicit DeviceBuffer(size_t count = 0) { allocate(count); }
+    ~DeviceBuffer() { if (data) cudaFree(data); }
+    DeviceBuffer(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    DeviceBuffer& operator=(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    void allocate(size_t count) {
+        if (!count) return;
+        if (count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(T)) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: device allocation size overflow\n", world_rank);
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    void tryCache(size_t count) {
+        const cudaError_t status = cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T));
+        if (status == cudaErrorMemoryAllocation) {
+            // The dense cache is optional; clustering still runs entirely on CUDA.
+            data = nullptr;
+            cudaGetLastError();
+        } else {
+            cudaCheck(status, "distance cache allocation");
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+template<class T> class PinnedBuffer {
+public:
+    T* data = nullptr;
+    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) {
+        if (count) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    ~PinnedBuffer() { if (data) cudaFreeHost(data); }
+    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+};
+
+class CudaStream {
+public:
+    cudaStream_t stream;
+    CudaStream() { CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking)); }
+    ~CudaStream() { cudaStreamDestroy(stream); }
+};

+static int hostThreads(size_t work) {
+    // Avoid creating large CPU teams for tiny GPU result buffers.
+    return static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(omp_get_max_threads(), std::max<size_t>(1, (work + 255) / 256)));
+}

+// In particular, do not compare squared distances: sqrt rounding can create
+// ties, and the sequential algorithm chooses the lowest point index on ties.
+__device__ __forceinline__ double pointDistance(Point a, Point b) {
+    const double dx = a.x - b.x;
+    const double dy = a.y - b.y;

+constexpr int GRAPH_THREADS = 128;
+constexpr int GRAPH_WARPS = GRAPH_THREADS / 32;
+using Offset = unsigned long long;

+// Each rank owns cyclic seed rows. A seed can only accept points within its
+// own threshold neighborhood, so this sparse graph is a safe candidate bound.
+__global__ void countNeighbors(const Point* points, int n, double threshold,
+                               int rank, int ranks, int* counts, int* warp_counts) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+    const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * warp / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * (warp + 1) / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    int count = 0;
+    const Point origin = points[seed];
+    for (long long i = static_cast<long long>(begin) + lane; i < end; i += 32)
+        count += i != seed && pointDistance(origin, points[i]) < threshold;
+    for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2)
+        count += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, count, offset);
+    __shared__ int totals[GRAPH_WARPS];
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        totals[warp] = count;
+        warp_counts[static_cast<size_t>(row) * GRAPH_WARPS + warp] = count;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        int total = 0;
+        for (int w = 0; w < GRAPH_WARPS; ++w) total += totals[w];
+        counts[row] = total;
+    }
+}

+// Warp ballots compact consecutive candidates into sorted CSR rows without
+// atomics. Sorted point indices also coalesce later distance-cache reads.
+__global__ void fillNeighbors(const Point* points, const double* distances,
+                              int n, double threshold, int rank, int ranks,
+                              const Offset* offsets, const int* warp_counts,
+                              int* neighbors) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    if (offsets[row] == offsets[row + 1]) return;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+    const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * warp / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * (warp + 1) / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    Offset position = offsets[row];
+    for (int w = 0; w < warp; ++w)
+        position += warp_counts[static_cast<size_t>(row) * GRAPH_WARPS + w];
+    for (long long base = begin; base < end; base += 32) {
+        const long long candidate = base + lane;
+        const bool eligible = candidate < end && candidate != seed &&
+            cachedDistance(points, distances, n, seed, static_cast<int>(candidate)) < threshold;
+        const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, eligible);
+        if (eligible)
+            neighbors[position + __popc(mask & ((1u << lane) - 1u))] = static_cast<int>(candidate);
+        position += __popc(mask);
+    }
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool closer(double d, int point, double best, int best_point) {
+    return d < best || (d == best && point < best_point);
+}

+// Each block grows one seed independently. Maintain the maximum distance to
+// the current cluster incrementally: adding one member requires one distance
+// per remaining candidate, rather than rescanning all previous members.
+// A cached cluster remains exact until one of its members is removed: deleting
+// an unchosen candidate cannot change any of the previous greedy decisions.
+template<int THREADS>
+__global__ void buildCandidates(const Point* points, const double* distances,
+                                int n, double threshold, int rank, int ranks,
+                                bool complete_graph, const unsigned char* active,
+                                const Offset* offsets, const int* neighbors,
+                                double* maxima, int* members, int* cardinalities) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    if (!active[seed] || (complete_graph && seed != 0)) {
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) cardinalities[row] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Offset begin = offsets[row];
+    const Offset end = offsets[row + 1];
+    const Offset member_begin = begin + row;
+    const int previous_size = cardinalities[row];
+    int dirty = previous_size == 0;
+    for (long long i = threadIdx.x; i < previous_size; i += THREADS)
+        dirty |= !active[members[member_begin + i]];
+    if (!__syncthreads_or(dirty)) return;
+
+    for (Offset e = begin + threadIdx.x; e < end; e += THREADS)
+        maxima[e] = active[neighbors[e]] ? 0.0 : DBL_MAX;
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) members[member_begin] = seed;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    constexpr int WARPS = THREADS / 32;
+    __shared__ double warp_distances[WARPS];
+    __shared__ int warp_points[WARPS];
+    __shared__ int next_point;
+    int last = seed;
+    int size = 1;
+    while (true) {
+        double best_distance = DBL_MAX;
+        int best_point = INT_MAX;
+        const Point last_point = points[last];
+        for (Offset e = begin + threadIdx.x; e < end; e += THREADS) {
+            double maximum = maxima[e];
+            if (!(maximum < threshold) || maximum == DBL_MAX) continue;
+            const int candidate = neighbors[e];
+            if (candidate == last) {
+                maxima[e] = DBL_MAX;
+                continue;
+            }
+            const double d = distances ? distances[static_cast<size_t>(last) * n + candidate]
+                                       : pointDistance(last_point, points[candidate]);
+            maximum = fmax(maximum, d);
+            maxima[e] = maximum;
+            if (maximum < threshold && closer(maximum, candidate, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                best_distance = maximum;
+                best_point = candidate;
+            }
+        }
+        for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2) {
+            const double d = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_distance, offset);
+            const int point = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_point, offset);
+            if (closer(d, point, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                best_distance = d;
+                best_point = point;
+            }
+        }
+        const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+        const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            warp_distances[warp] = best_distance;
+            warp_points[warp] = best_point;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        if (warp == 0) {
+            best_distance = lane < WARPS ? warp_distances[lane] : DBL_MAX;
+            best_point = lane < WARPS ? warp_points[lane] : INT_MAX;
+            for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2) {
+                const double d = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_distance, offset);
+                const int point = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_point, offset);
+                if (closer(d, point, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                    best_distance = d;
+                    best_point = point;
+                }
+            }
+            if (lane == 0) {
+                next_point = best_point;
+                if (best_point != INT_MAX) members[member_begin + size] = best_point;
+                else cardinalities[row] = size;
+            }
         }
+        __syncthreads();
+        last = next_point;
+        if (last == INT_MAX) break;
+        ++size;
     }
-    
-    return closest_point;

+static std::vector<Offset> rowOffsets(const int* counts, int rows) {

+static int world_rank = 0;

+static void mpiCheck(int status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+    fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s: %.*s\n", world_rank, operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+static void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) return;
+    fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s: %s\n", world_rank, operation, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(operation) cudaCheck((operation), #operation)
+#define MPI_CHECK(operation) mpiCheck((operation), #operation)
+
+class MpiRuntime {
+public:
+    MpiRuntime(int& argc, char**& argv) {
+        int provided = 0;
+        if (MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided) != MPI_SUCCESS)
+            std::exit(1);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_set_errhandler(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_ERRORS_RETURN));
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &world_rank));
+        if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED is required.\n");
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+        }
+    }
+    ~MpiRuntime() { MPI_Finalize(); }
+    MpiRuntime(const MpiRuntime&) = delete;
+    MpiRuntime& operator=(const MpiRuntime&) = delete;
+};
+
+template<class T> class DeviceBuffer {
+public:
+    T* data = nullptr;
+    explicit DeviceBuffer(size_t count = 0) { allocate(count); }
+    ~DeviceBuffer() { if (data) cudaFree(data); }
+    DeviceBuffer(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    DeviceBuffer& operator=(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    void allocate(size_t count) {
+        if (!count) return;
+        if (count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(T)) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: device allocation size overflow\n", world_rank);
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    void tryCache(size_t count) {
+        const cudaError_t status = cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T));
+        if (status == cudaErrorMemoryAllocation) {
+            // The dense cache is optional; clustering still runs entirely on CUDA.
+            data = nullptr;
+            cudaGetLastError();
+        } else {
+            cudaCheck(status, "distance cache allocation");
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+template<class T> class PinnedBuffer {
+public:
+    T* data = nullptr;
+    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) {
+        if (count) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    ~PinnedBuffer() { if (data) cudaFreeHost(data); }
+    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+};
+
+class CudaStream {
+public:
+    cudaStream_t stream;
+    CudaStream() { CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking)); }
+    ~CudaStream() { cudaStreamDestroy(stream); }
+};

+static int hostThreads(size_t work) {
+    // Avoid creating large CPU teams for tiny GPU result buffers.
+    return static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(omp_get_max_threads(), std::max<size_t>(1, (work + 255) / 256)));
+}

+// Use the same double arithmetic as the FMA-enabled host distance function.
+// In particular, do not compare squared distances: sqrt rounding can create
+// ties, and the sequential algorithm chooses the lowest point index on ties.
+__device__ __forceinline__ double pointDistance(Point a, Point b) {
+    const double dx = a.x - b.x;
+    const double dy = a.y - b.y;
+    return __dsqrt_rn(__fma_rn(dx, dx, __dmul_rn(dy, dy)));
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ double cachedDistance(const Point* points,
+                                                const double* distances,
+                                                int n, int a, int b) {
+    return distances ? distances[static_cast<size_t>(a) * n + b]
+                     : pointDistance(points[a], points[b]);

+// Compute each unordered pair once, and store both orientations. The dense
+// cache is bounded by available device memory; sparse rows never depend on it.
+__global__ void buildDistances(const Point* points, double* distances, int n) {

+    __shared__ Point row_points[32];

+    if (threadIdx.y == 0 && column < n) column_points[threadIdx.x] = points[column];

+        row_points[threadIdx.x] = points[row_base + threadIdx.x];

+            distances[static_cast<size_t>(row) * n + column] = d;
+            distances[static_cast<size_t>(column) * n + row] = d;

+constexpr int GRAPH_THREADS = 128;
+constexpr int GRAPH_WARPS = GRAPH_THREADS / 32;
+using Offset = unsigned long long;

+// Each rank owns cyclic seed rows. A seed can only accept points within its
+// own threshold neighborhood, so this sparse graph is a safe candidate bound.
+__global__ void countNeighbors(const Point* points, int n, double threshold,
+                               int rank, int ranks, int* counts, int* warp_counts) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+    const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * warp / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * (warp + 1) / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    int count = 0;
+    const Point origin = points[seed];
+    for (long long i = static_cast<long long>(begin) + lane; i < end; i += 32)
+        count += i != seed && pointDistance(origin, points[i]) < threshold;
+    for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2)
+        count += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, count, offset);
+    __shared__ int totals[GRAPH_WARPS];
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        totals[warp] = count;
+        warp_counts[static_cast<size_t>(row) * GRAPH_WARPS + warp] = count;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        int total = 0;
+        for (int w = 0; w < GRAPH_WARPS; ++w) total += totals[w];
+        counts[row] = total;
+    }
+}
+
+// Warp ballots compact consecutive candidates into sorted CSR rows without
+// atomics. Sorted point indices also coalesce later distance-cache reads.
+__global__ void fillNeighbors(const Point* points, const double* distances,
+                              int n, double threshold, int rank, int ranks,
+                              const Offset* offsets, const int* warp_counts,
+                              int* neighbors) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    if (offsets[row] == offsets[row + 1]) return;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+    const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * warp / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * (warp + 1) / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    Offset position = offsets[row];
+    for (int w = 0; w < warp; ++w)
+        position += warp_counts[static_cast<size_t>(row) * GRAPH_WARPS + w];
+    for (long long base = begin; base < end; base += 32) {
+        const long long candidate = base + lane;
+        const bool eligible = candidate < end && candidate != seed &&
+            cachedDistance(points, distances, n, seed, static_cast<int>(candidate)) < threshold;
+        const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, eligible);
+        if (eligible)
+            neighbors[position + __popc(mask & ((1u << lane) - 1u))] = static_cast<int>(candidate);
+        position += __popc(mask);
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool closer(double d, int point, double best, int best_point) {
+    return d < best || (d == best && point < best_point);
+}
+
+// Each block grows one seed independently. Maintain the maximum distance to
+// the current cluster incrementally: adding one member requires one distance
+// per remaining candidate, rather than rescanning all previous members.
+// A cached cluster remains exact until one of its members is removed: deleting
+// an unchosen candidate cannot change any of the previous greedy decisions.
+template<int THREADS>
+__global__ void buildCandidates(const Point* points, const double* distances,
+                                int n, double threshold, int rank, int ranks,
+                                bool complete_graph, const unsigned char* active,
+                                const Offset* offsets, const int* neighbors,
+                                double* maxima, int* members, int* cardinalities) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    if (!active[seed] || (complete_graph && seed != 0)) {
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) cardinalities[row] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Offset begin = offsets[row];
+    const Offset end = offsets[row + 1];
+    const Offset member_begin = begin + row;
+    const int previous_size = cardinalities[row];
+    int dirty = previous_size == 0;
+    for (long long i = threadIdx.x; i < previous_size; i += THREADS)
+        dirty |= !active[members[member_begin + i]];
+    if (!__syncthreads_or(dirty)) return;
+
+    for (Offset e = begin + threadIdx.x; e < end; e += THREADS)
+        maxima[e] = active[neighbors[e]] ? 0.0 : DBL_MAX;
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) members[member_begin] = seed;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    constexpr int WARPS = THREADS / 32;
+    __shared__ double warp_distances[WARPS];
+    __shared__ int warp_points[WARPS];
+    __shared__ int next_point;
+    int last = seed;
+    int size = 1;
+    while (true) {
+        double best_distance = DBL_MAX;
+        int best_point = INT_MAX;
+        const Point last_point = points[last];
+        for (Offset e = begin + threadIdx.x; e < end; e += THREADS) {
+            double maximum = maxima[e];
+            if (!(maximum < threshold) || maximum == DBL_MAX) continue;
+            const int candidate = neighbors[e];
+            if (candidate == last) {
+                maxima[e] = DBL_MAX;
+                continue;
+            }
+            const double d = distances ? distances[static_cast<size_t>(last) * n + candidate]
+                                       : pointDistance(last_point, points[candidate]);
+            maximum = fmax(maximum, d);
+            maxima[e] = maximum;
+            if (maximum < threshold && closer(maximum, candidate, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                best_distance = maximum;
+                best_point = candidate;
+            }
+        }
+        for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2) {
+            const double d = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_distance, offset);
+            const int point = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_point, offset);
+            if (closer(d, point, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                best_distance = d;
+                best_point = point;
+            }
+        }
+        const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+        const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            warp_distances[warp] = best_distance;
+            warp_points[warp] = best_point;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        if (warp == 0) {
+            best_distance = lane < WARPS ? warp_distances[lane] : DBL_MAX;
+            best_point = lane < WARPS ? warp_points[lane] : INT_MAX;
+            for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2) {
+                const double d = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_distance, offset);
+                const int point = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_point, offset);
+                if (closer(d, point, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                    best_distance = d;
+                    best_point = point;
+                }
+            }
+            if (lane == 0) {
+                next_point = best_point;
+                if (best_point != INT_MAX) members[member_begin + size] = best_point;
+                else cardinalities[row] = size;
+            }
         }
+        __syncthreads();
+        last = next_point;
+        if (last == INT_MAX) break;
+        ++size;
     }
-    
-    return closest_point;
 }

+static std::vector<Offset> rowOffsets(const int* counts, int rows) {
+    std::vector<Offset> offsets(static_cast<size_t>(rows) + 1);
+    const int threads = hostThreads(rows);
+    std::vector<Offset> totals(threads);
+    #pragma omp parallel num_threads(threads)
+    {
+        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();
+        const int team = omp_get_num_threads();
+        const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(rows) * tid / team);
+        const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(rows) * (tid + 1) / team);
+        Offset sum = 0;
+        for (int row = begin; row < end; ++row) {
+            offsets[row] = sum;
+            sum += counts[row];
+        }
+        totals[tid] = sum;

+        #pragma omp single
+        {

+            for (int t = 0; t < team; ++t) {

+                prefix += value;
+            }
+            offsets[rows] = prefix;
+        }

+static void mpiCheck(int status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+    fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s: %.*s\n", world_rank, operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+static void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) return;
+    fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s: %s\n", world_rank, operation, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    std::abort();
+}

+#define CUDA_CHECK(operation) cudaCheck((operation), #operation)
+#define MPI_CHECK(operation) mpiCheck((operation), #operation)

+class MpiRuntime {
+public:
+    MpiRuntime(int& argc, char**& argv) {
+        int provided = 0;
+        if (MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided) != MPI_SUCCESS)
+            std::exit(1);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_set_errhandler(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_ERRORS_RETURN));
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &world_rank));
+        if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED is required.\n");
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+        }
+    }
+    ~MpiRuntime() { MPI_Finalize(); }
+    MpiRuntime(const MpiRuntime&) = delete;
+    MpiRuntime& operator=(const MpiRuntime&) = delete;
+};

+template<class T> class DeviceBuffer {
+public:
+    T* data = nullptr;
+    explicit DeviceBuffer(size_t count = 0) { allocate(count); }
+    ~DeviceBuffer() { if (data) cudaFree(data); }
+    DeviceBuffer(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    DeviceBuffer& operator=(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    void allocate(size_t count) {
+        if (!count) return;
+        if (count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(T)) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: device allocation size overflow\n", world_rank);
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    void tryCache(size_t count) {
+        const cudaError_t status = cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T));
+        if (status == cudaErrorMemoryAllocation) {
+            // The dense cache is optional; clustering still runs entirely on CUDA.
+            data = nullptr;
+            cudaGetLastError();
+        } else {
+            cudaCheck(status, "distance cache allocation");
+        }
+    }
+};

+// Use the same double arithmetic as the FMA-enabled host distance function.
+// In particular, do not compare squared distances: sqrt rounding can create
+// ties, and the sequential algorithm chooses the lowest point index on ties.
+__device__ __forceinline__ double pointDistance(Point a, Point b) {
+    const double dx = a.x - b.x;
+    const double dy = a.y - b.y;

+__device__ __forceinline__ double cachedDistance(const Point* points,

+// Compute each unordered pair once, and store both orientations. The dense
+// cache is bounded by available device memory; sparse rows never depend on it.
+__global__ void buildDistances(const Point* points, double* distances, int n) {
+    if (blockIdx.y > blockIdx.x) return;
+    __shared__ Point column_points[32];
+    __shared__ Point row_points[32];

+constexpr int GRAPH_THREADS = 128;
+constexpr int GRAPH_WARPS = GRAPH_THREADS / 32;
+using Offset = unsigned long long;
+
+// Each rank owns cyclic seed rows. A seed can only accept points within its
+// own threshold neighborhood, so this sparse graph is a safe candidate bound.
+__global__ void countNeighbors(const Point* points, int n, double threshold,
+                               int rank, int ranks, int* counts, int* warp_counts) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+    const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * warp / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * (warp + 1) / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    int count = 0;
+    const Point origin = points[seed];
+    for (long long i = static_cast<long long>(begin) + lane; i < end; i += 32)
+        count += i != seed && pointDistance(origin, points[i]) < threshold;
+    for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2)
+        count += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, count, offset);
+    __shared__ int totals[GRAPH_WARPS];
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        totals[warp] = count;
+        warp_counts[static_cast<size_t>(row) * GRAPH_WARPS + warp] = count;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        int total = 0;
+        for (int w = 0; w < GRAPH_WARPS; ++w) total += totals[w];
+        counts[row] = total;
+    }
+}
+
+// Warp ballots compact consecutive candidates into sorted CSR rows without
+// atomics. Sorted point indices also coalesce later distance-cache reads.
+__global__ void fillNeighbors(const Point* points, const double* distances,
+                              int n, double threshold, int rank, int ranks,
+                              const Offset* offsets, const int* warp_counts,
+                              int* neighbors) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    if (offsets[row] == offsets[row + 1]) return;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+    const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * warp / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * (warp + 1) / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    Offset position = offsets[row];
+    for (int w = 0; w < warp; ++w)
+        position += warp_counts[static_cast<size_t>(row) * GRAPH_WARPS + w];
+    for (long long base = begin; base < end; base += 32) {
+        const long long candidate = base + lane;
+        const bool eligible = candidate < end && candidate != seed &&
+            cachedDistance(points, distances, n, seed, static_cast<int>(candidate)) < threshold;
+        const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, eligible);
+        if (eligible)
+            neighbors[position + __popc(mask & ((1u << lane) - 1u))] = static_cast<int>(candidate);
+        position += __popc(mask);
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool closer(double d, int point, double best, int best_point) {
+    return d < best || (d == best && point < best_point);
+}
+
+// Each block grows one seed independently. Maintain the maximum distance to
+// the current cluster incrementally: adding one member requires one distance
+// per remaining candidate, rather than rescanning all previous members.
+// A cached cluster remains exact until one of its members is removed: deleting
+// an unchosen candidate cannot change any of the previous greedy decisions.
+template<int THREADS>
+__global__ void buildCandidates(const Point* points, const double* distances,
+                                int n, double threshold, int rank, int ranks,
+                                bool complete_graph, const unsigned char* active,
+                                const Offset* offsets, const int* neighbors,
+                                double* maxima, int* members, int* cardinalities) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    if (!active[seed] || (complete_graph && seed != 0)) {
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) cardinalities[row] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Offset begin = offsets[row];
+    const Offset end = offsets[row + 1];
+    const Offset member_begin = begin + row;
+    const int previous_size = cardinalities[row];
+    int dirty = previous_size == 0;
+    for (long long i = threadIdx.x; i < previous_size; i += THREADS)
+        dirty |= !active[members[member_begin + i]];
+    if (!__syncthreads_or(dirty)) return;
+
+    for (Offset e = begin + threadIdx.x; e < end; e += THREADS)
+        maxima[e] = active[neighbors[e]] ? 0.0 : DBL_MAX;
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) members[member_begin] = seed;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    constexpr int WARPS = THREADS / 32;
+    __shared__ double warp_distances[WARPS];
+    __shared__ int warp_points[WARPS];
+    __shared__ int next_point;
+    int last = seed;
+    int size = 1;
+    while (true) {
+        double best_distance = DBL_MAX;
+        int best_point = INT_MAX;
+        const Point last_point = points[last];
+        for (Offset e = begin + threadIdx.x; e < end; e += THREADS) {
+            double maximum = maxima[e];
+            if (!(maximum < threshold) || maximum == DBL_MAX) continue;
+            const int candidate = neighbors[e];
+            if (candidate == last) {
+                maxima[e] = DBL_MAX;
+                continue;
+            }
+            const double d = distances ? distances[static_cast<size_t>(last) * n + candidate]
+                                       : pointDistance(last_point, points[candidate]);
+            maximum = fmax(maximum, d);
+            maxima[e] = maximum;
+            if (maximum < threshold && closer(maximum, candidate, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                best_distance = maximum;
+                best_point = candidate;
+            }
+        }
+        for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2) {
+            const double d = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_distance, offset);
+            const int point = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_point, offset);
+            if (closer(d, point, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                best_distance = d;
+                best_point = point;
+            }
+        }
+        const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+        const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            warp_distances[warp] = best_distance;
+            warp_points[warp] = best_point;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        if (warp == 0) {
+            best_distance = lane < WARPS ? warp_distances[lane] : DBL_MAX;
+            best_point = lane < WARPS ? warp_points[lane] : INT_MAX;
+            for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2) {
+                const double d = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_distance, offset);
+                const int point = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_point, offset);
+                if (closer(d, point, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                    best_distance = d;
+                    best_point = point;
+                }
+            }
+            if (lane == 0) {
+                next_point = best_point;
+                if (best_point != INT_MAX) members[member_begin + size] = best_point;
+                else cardinalities[row] = size;
+            }
         }
+        __syncthreads();
+        last = next_point;
+        if (last == INT_MAX) break;
+        ++size;
     }
-    
-    return closest_point;
 }

+static std::vector<Offset> rowOffsets(const int* counts, int rows) {
+    std::vector<Offset> offsets(static_cast<size_t>(rows) + 1);
+    const int threads = hostThreads(rows);
+    std::vector<Offset> totals(threads);
+    #pragma omp parallel num_threads(threads)
+    {
+        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();
+        const int team = omp_get_num_threads();
+        const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(rows) * tid / team);
+        const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(rows) * (tid + 1) / team);
+        Offset sum = 0;
+        for (int row = begin; row < end; ++row) {
+            offsets[row] = sum;

+        }

+        #pragma omp single

+                totals[t] = prefix;
+                prefix += value;
+            }
+            offsets[rows] = prefix;
+        }

+static void mpiCheck(int status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+    fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s: %.*s\n", world_rank, operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    std::abort();
+}

+static void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) return;
+    fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s: %s\n", world_rank, operation, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    std::abort();
+}

+class MpiRuntime {
+public:
+    MpiRuntime(int& argc, char**& argv) {
+        int provided = 0;
+        if (MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided) != MPI_SUCCESS)
+            std::exit(1);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_set_errhandler(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_ERRORS_RETURN));
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &world_rank));
+        if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED is required.\n");
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+        }
+    }

+    MpiRuntime(const MpiRuntime&) = delete;
+    MpiRuntime& operator=(const MpiRuntime&) = delete;
+};

+template<class T> class DeviceBuffer {
+public:
+    T* data = nullptr;
+    explicit DeviceBuffer(size_t count = 0) { allocate(count); }
+    ~DeviceBuffer() { if (data) cudaFree(data); }
+    DeviceBuffer(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    DeviceBuffer& operator=(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    void allocate(size_t count) {
+        if (!count) return;
+        if (count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(T)) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: device allocation size overflow\n", world_rank);
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    void tryCache(size_t count) {
+        const cudaError_t status = cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T));
+        if (status == cudaErrorMemoryAllocation) {
+            // The dense cache is optional; clustering still runs entirely on CUDA.
+            data = nullptr;
+            cudaGetLastError();
+        } else {

+        }
+    }

+// Use the same double arithmetic as the FMA-enabled host distance function.
+// In particular, do not compare squared distances: sqrt rounding can create
+// ties, and the sequential algorithm chooses the lowest point index on ties.
+__device__ __forceinline__ double pointDistance(Point a, Point b) {

+    const double dy = a.y - b.y;

+constexpr int GRAPH_THREADS = 128;
+constexpr int GRAPH_WARPS = GRAPH_THREADS / 32;
+using Offset = unsigned long long;

+// Each rank owns cyclic seed rows. A seed can only accept points within its
+// own threshold neighborhood, so this sparse graph is a safe candidate bound.
+__global__ void countNeighbors(const Point* points, int n, double threshold,
+                               int rank, int ranks, int* counts, int* warp_counts) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+    const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * warp / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * (warp + 1) / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    int count = 0;
+    const Point origin = points[seed];
+    for (long long i = static_cast<long long>(begin) + lane; i < end; i += 32)
+        count += i != seed && pointDistance(origin, points[i]) < threshold;
+    for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2)
+        count += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, count, offset);
+    __shared__ int totals[GRAPH_WARPS];
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        totals[warp] = count;
+        warp_counts[static_cast<size_t>(row) * GRAPH_WARPS + warp] = count;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        int total = 0;
+        for (int w = 0; w < GRAPH_WARPS; ++w) total += totals[w];
+        counts[row] = total;
+    }
+}
+
+// Warp ballots compact consecutive candidates into sorted CSR rows without
+// atomics. Sorted point indices also coalesce later distance-cache reads.
+__global__ void fillNeighbors(const Point* points, const double* distances,
+                              int n, double threshold, int rank, int ranks,
+                              const Offset* offsets, const int* warp_counts,
+                              int* neighbors) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    if (offsets[row] == offsets[row + 1]) return;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+    const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * warp / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * (warp + 1) / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    Offset position = offsets[row];
+    for (int w = 0; w < warp; ++w)
+        position += warp_counts[static_cast<size_t>(row) * GRAPH_WARPS + w];
+    for (long long base = begin; base < end; base += 32) {
+        const long long candidate = base + lane;
+        const bool eligible = candidate < end && candidate != seed &&
+            cachedDistance(points, distances, n, seed, static_cast<int>(candidate)) < threshold;
+        const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, eligible);
+        if (eligible)
+            neighbors[position + __popc(mask & ((1u << lane) - 1u))] = static_cast<int>(candidate);
+        position += __popc(mask);
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool closer(double d, int point, double best, int best_point) {
+    return d < best || (d == best && point < best_point);
+}
+
+// Each block grows one seed independently. Maintain the maximum distance to
+// the current cluster incrementally: adding one member requires one distance
+// per remaining candidate, rather than rescanning all previous members.
+// A cached cluster remains exact until one of its members is removed: deleting
+// an unchosen candidate cannot change any of the previous greedy decisions.
+template<int THREADS>
+__global__ void buildCandidates(const Point* points, const double* distances,
+                                int n, double threshold, int rank, int ranks,
+                                bool complete_graph, const unsigned char* active,
+                                const Offset* offsets, const int* neighbors,
+                                double* maxima, int* members, int* cardinalities) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    if (!active[seed] || (complete_graph && seed != 0)) {
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) cardinalities[row] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Offset begin = offsets[row];
+    const Offset end = offsets[row + 1];
+    const Offset member_begin = begin + row;
+    const int previous_size = cardinalities[row];
+    int dirty = previous_size == 0;
+    for (long long i = threadIdx.x; i < previous_size; i += THREADS)
+        dirty |= !active[members[member_begin + i]];
+    if (!__syncthreads_or(dirty)) return;
+
+    for (Offset e = begin + threadIdx.x; e < end; e += THREADS)
+        maxima[e] = active[neighbors[e]] ? 0.0 : DBL_MAX;
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) members[member_begin] = seed;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    constexpr int WARPS = THREADS / 32;
+    __shared__ double warp_distances[WARPS];
+    __shared__ int warp_points[WARPS];
+    __shared__ int next_point;
+    int last = seed;
+    int size = 1;
+    while (true) {
+        double best_distance = DBL_MAX;
+        int best_point = INT_MAX;
+        const Point last_point = points[last];
+        for (Offset e = begin + threadIdx.x; e < end; e += THREADS) {
+            double maximum = maxima[e];
+            if (!(maximum < threshold) || maximum == DBL_MAX) continue;
+            const int candidate = neighbors[e];
+            if (candidate == last) {
+                maxima[e] = DBL_MAX;
+                continue;
+            }
+            const double d = distances ? distances[static_cast<size_t>(last) * n + candidate]
+                                       : pointDistance(last_point, points[candidate]);
+            maximum = fmax(maximum, d);
+            maxima[e] = maximum;
+            if (maximum < threshold && closer(maximum, candidate, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                best_distance = maximum;
+                best_point = candidate;
+            }
+        }
+        for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2) {
+            const double d = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_distance, offset);
+            const int point = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_point, offset);
+            if (closer(d, point, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                best_distance = d;
+                best_point = point;
+            }
+        }
+        const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+        const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            warp_distances[warp] = best_distance;
+            warp_points[warp] = best_point;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        if (warp == 0) {
+            best_distance = lane < WARPS ? warp_distances[lane] : DBL_MAX;

+static std::vector<Offset> rowOffsets(const int* counts, int rows) {
+    std::vector<Offset> offsets(static_cast<size_t>(rows) + 1);
+    const int threads = hostThreads(rows);
+    std::vector<Offset> totals(threads);
+    #pragma omp parallel num_threads(threads)
+    {
+        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();
+        const int team = omp_get_num_threads();
+        const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(rows) * tid / team);
+        const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(rows) * (tid + 1) / team);
+        Offset sum = 0;
+        for (int row = begin; row < end; ++row) {
+            offsets[row] = sum;
+            sum += counts[row];
+        }
+        totals[tid] = sum;
+        #pragma omp barrier
+        #pragma omp single
+        {
+            Offset prefix = 0;
+            for (int t = 0; t < team; ++t) {
+                const Offset value = totals[t];
+                totals[t] = prefix;
+                prefix += value;
+            }
+            offsets[rows] = prefix;
+        }
+        #pragma omp barrier
+        for (int row = begin; row < end; ++row) offsets[row] += totals[tid];
     }
-

+    return offsets;

+static int world_rank = 0;

+static void mpiCheck(int status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+    fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s: %.*s\n", world_rank, operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+static void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) return;
+    fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s: %s\n", world_rank, operation, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(operation) cudaCheck((operation), #operation)
+#define MPI_CHECK(operation) mpiCheck((operation), #operation)
+
+class MpiRuntime {
+public:
+    MpiRuntime(int& argc, char**& argv) {
+        int provided = 0;
+        if (MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided) != MPI_SUCCESS)
+            std::exit(1);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_set_errhandler(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_ERRORS_RETURN));
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &world_rank));
+        if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED is required.\n");
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+        }
+    }
+    ~MpiRuntime() { MPI_Finalize(); }
+    MpiRuntime(const MpiRuntime&) = delete;
+    MpiRuntime& operator=(const MpiRuntime&) = delete;
+};
+
+template<class T> class DeviceBuffer {
+public:
+    T* data = nullptr;
+    explicit DeviceBuffer(size_t count = 0) { allocate(count); }
+    ~DeviceBuffer() { if (data) cudaFree(data); }
+    DeviceBuffer(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    DeviceBuffer& operator=(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    void allocate(size_t count) {
+        if (!count) return;
+        if (count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(T)) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: device allocation size overflow\n", world_rank);
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    void tryCache(size_t count) {
+        const cudaError_t status = cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T));
+        if (status == cudaErrorMemoryAllocation) {
+            // The dense cache is optional; clustering still runs entirely on CUDA.
+            data = nullptr;
+            cudaGetLastError();
+        } else {
+            cudaCheck(status, "distance cache allocation");
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+template<class T> class PinnedBuffer {
+public:
+    T* data = nullptr;
+    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) {
+        if (count) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    ~PinnedBuffer() { if (data) cudaFreeHost(data); }
+    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+};

+static int hostThreads(size_t work) {

+// Use the same double arithmetic as the FMA-enabled host distance function.
+// In particular, do not compare squared distances: sqrt rounding can create
+// ties, and the sequential algorithm chooses the lowest point index on ties.
+__device__ __forceinline__ double pointDistance(Point a, Point b) {
+    const double dx = a.x - b.x;
+    const double dy = a.y - b.y;
+    return __dsqrt_rn(__fma_rn(dx, dx, __dmul_rn(dy, dy)));
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ double cachedDistance(const Point* points,
+                                                const double* distances,
+                                                int n, int a, int b) {
+    return distances ? distances[static_cast<size_t>(a) * n + b]
+                     : pointDistance(points[a], points[b]);

+// Compute each unordered pair once, and store both orientations. The dense
+// cache is bounded by available device memory; sparse rows never depend on it.
+__global__ void buildDistances(const Point* points, double* distances, int n) {
+    if (blockIdx.y > blockIdx.x) return;
+    __shared__ Point column_points[32];
+    __shared__ Point row_points[32];

+    if (threadIdx.y == 0 && column < n) column_points[threadIdx.x] = points[column];
+    const int row_base = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * 32;
+    if (threadIdx.y == 1 && row_base + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) < n)
+        row_points[threadIdx.x] = points[row_base + threadIdx.x];
+    __syncthreads();

+        const int row = row_base + r;
+        if (column < n && row < n && column >= row) {

+            distances[static_cast<size_t>(row) * n + column] = d;
+            distances[static_cast<size_t>(column) * n + row] = d;

+constexpr int GRAPH_THREADS = 128;
+constexpr int GRAPH_WARPS = GRAPH_THREADS / 32;
+using Offset = unsigned long long;

+// Each rank owns cyclic seed rows. A seed can only accept points within its
+// own threshold neighborhood, so this sparse graph is a safe candidate bound.
+__global__ void countNeighbors(const Point* points, int n, double threshold,
+                               int rank, int ranks, int* counts, int* warp_counts) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+    const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * warp / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * (warp + 1) / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    int count = 0;
+    const Point origin = points[seed];
+    for (long long i = static_cast<long long>(begin) + lane; i < end; i += 32)
+        count += i != seed && pointDistance(origin, points[i]) < threshold;
+    for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2)
+        count += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, count, offset);
+    __shared__ int totals[GRAPH_WARPS];
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        totals[warp] = count;
+        warp_counts[static_cast<size_t>(row) * GRAPH_WARPS + warp] = count;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        int total = 0;
+        for (int w = 0; w < GRAPH_WARPS; ++w) total += totals[w];
+        counts[row] = total;
+    }
+}

+// Warp ballots compact consecutive candidates into sorted CSR rows without
+// atomics. Sorted point indices also coalesce later distance-cache reads.
+__global__ void fillNeighbors(const Point* points, const double* distances,
+                              int n, double threshold, int rank, int ranks,
+                              const Offset* offsets, const int* warp_counts,
+                              int* neighbors) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    if (offsets[row] == offsets[row + 1]) return;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+    const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * warp / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * (warp + 1) / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    Offset position = offsets[row];
+    for (int w = 0; w < warp; ++w)
+        position += warp_counts[static_cast<size_t>(row) * GRAPH_WARPS + w];
+    for (long long base = begin; base < end; base += 32) {
+        const long long candidate = base + lane;
+        const bool eligible = candidate < end && candidate != seed &&
+            cachedDistance(points, distances, n, seed, static_cast<int>(candidate)) < threshold;
+        const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, eligible);
+        if (eligible)
+            neighbors[position + __popc(mask & ((1u << lane) - 1u))] = static_cast<int>(candidate);
+        position += __popc(mask);
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool closer(double d, int point, double best, int best_point) {
+    return d < best || (d == best && point < best_point);
+}
+
+// Each block grows one seed independently. Maintain the maximum distance to
+// the current cluster incrementally: adding one member requires one distance
+// per remaining candidate, rather than rescanning all previous members.
+// A cached cluster remains exact until one of its members is removed: deleting
+// an unchosen candidate cannot change any of the previous greedy decisions.
+template<int THREADS>
+__global__ void buildCandidates(const Point* points, const double* distances,
+                                int n, double threshold, int rank, int ranks,
+                                bool complete_graph, const unsigned char* active,
+                                const Offset* offsets, const int* neighbors,
+                                double* maxima, int* members, int* cardinalities) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    if (!active[seed] || (complete_graph && seed != 0)) {
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) cardinalities[row] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Offset begin = offsets[row];
+    const Offset end = offsets[row + 1];
+    const Offset member_begin = begin + row;
+    const int previous_size = cardinalities[row];
+    int dirty = previous_size == 0;
+    for (long long i = threadIdx.x; i < previous_size; i += THREADS)
+        dirty |= !active[members[member_begin + i]];
+    if (!__syncthreads_or(dirty)) return;
+
+    for (Offset e = begin + threadIdx.x; e < end; e += THREADS)
+        maxima[e] = active[neighbors[e]] ? 0.0 : DBL_MAX;
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) members[member_begin] = seed;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    constexpr int WARPS = THREADS / 32;
+    __shared__ double warp_distances[WARPS];
+    __shared__ int warp_points[WARPS];
+    __shared__ int next_point;
+    int last = seed;
+    int size = 1;
+    while (true) {
+        double best_distance = DBL_MAX;
+        int best_point = INT_MAX;
+        const Point last_point = points[last];
+        for (Offset e = begin + threadIdx.x; e < end; e += THREADS) {
+            double maximum = maxima[e];
+            if (!(maximum < threshold) || maximum == DBL_MAX) continue;
+            const int candidate = neighbors[e];
+            if (candidate == last) {
+                maxima[e] = DBL_MAX;
+                continue;
+            }
+            const double d = distances ? distances[static_cast<size_t>(last) * n + candidate]
+                                       : pointDistance(last_point, points[candidate]);
+            maximum = fmax(maximum, d);
+            maxima[e] = maximum;
+            if (maximum < threshold && closer(maximum, candidate, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                best_distance = maximum;
+                best_point = candidate;
+            }
+        }
+        for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2) {
+            const double d = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_distance, offset);
+            const int point = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_point, offset);
+            if (closer(d, point, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                best_distance = d;
+                best_point = point;
+            }
+        }
+        const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+        const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            warp_distances[warp] = best_distance;
+            warp_points[warp] = best_point;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        if (warp == 0) {
+            best_distance = lane < WARPS ? warp_distances[lane] : DBL_MAX;
+            best_point = lane < WARPS ? warp_points[lane] : INT_MAX;
+            for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2) {
+                const double d = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_distance, offset);
+                const int point = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_point, offset);
+                if (closer(d, point, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                    best_distance = d;
+                    best_point = point;
+                }
+            }
+            if (lane == 0) {
+                next_point = best_point;
+                if (best_point != INT_MAX) members[member_begin + size] = best_point;
+                else cardinalities[row] = size;
+            }
         }
+        __syncthreads();
+        last = next_point;
+        if (last == INT_MAX) break;
+        ++size;
     }
-    
-    return closest_point;
 }

+static std::vector<Offset> rowOffsets(const int* counts, int rows) {
+    std::vector<Offset> offsets(static_cast<size_t>(rows) + 1);
+    const int threads = hostThreads(rows);
+    std::vector<Offset> totals(threads);
+    #pragma omp parallel num_threads(threads)
+    {
+        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();
+        const int team = omp_get_num_threads();
+        const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(rows) * tid / team);
+        const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(rows) * (tid + 1) / team);
+        Offset sum = 0;

static double originalDistance(Point a, Point b) {
    const double dx = a.x - b.x, dy = a.y - b.y;
    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
}
static std::vector<int> originalCandidate(int seed, const std::vector<Point>& p,
                                           const std::vector<unsigned char>& active, double threshold) {
    std::vector<int> members{seed};
    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(p.size(), false);
    in_cluster[seed] = true;
    while (members.size() < p.size()) {
        int closest = -1;
        double best = DBL_MAX;
        for (int candidate = 0; candidate < static_cast<int>(p.size()); ++candidate) {
            if ("'!active[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;
            double maximum = 0.0;
            for (int member : members)
                maximum = std::max(maximum, originalDistance(p[candidate], p[member]));
            if (maximum < threshold && maximum < best) {
                best = maximum;
                closest = candidate;
            }
        }
        if (closest < 0) break;
        members.push_back(closest);
        in_cluster[closest] = true;
    }
    return members;
}
static std::vector<Cluster> originalQT(const std::vector<Point>& p, double threshold) {
    std::vector<unsigned char> active(p.size(), 1);
    std::vector<Cluster> result;
    int remaining = p.size();
    while (remaining) {
        Cluster best;
        for (int seed = 0; seed < static_cast<int>(p.size()); ++seed) {
            if (!active[seed]) continue;
            auto members = originalCandidate(seed, p, active, threshold);
            if (members.size() > best.members.size()) best = {members, seed};
        }
        for (int member : best.members) active[member] = 0;
        remaining -= best.members.size();
        result.push_back(best);
    }
    return result;
}
static void require(bool valid, const char* label, int test) {
    if (!valid) {
        fprintf(stderr, "FAIL rank=%d %s test=%d'"\\n\", world_rank, label, test);
        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 7);
    }
}
static void checkQt(const std::vector<Point>& p, double threshold, int test) {
    const auto actual = qtClustering(p, threshold);
    if (world_rank == 0) {
        const auto expected = originalQT(p, threshold);
        require(actual.size() == expected.size(), \"cluster count\", test);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < expected.size(); ++i)
            require(actual[i].seed_point == expected[i].seed_point &&
                    actual[i].members == expected[i].members, \"exact seeds and member order\", test);
    }
}
// Exercise the on-demand distance path directly, including cached candidate
// invalidation after deletions, independently of available cache memory.
static void checkWithoutCache(const std::vector<Point>& p, double threshold, int ranks) {
    const int n = p.size();
    const int rows = n / ranks + (world_rank < n % ranks);
    std::vector<Offset> offsets(rows + 1);
    std::vector<int> graph;
    for (int row = 0; row < rows; ++row) {
        offsets[row] = graph.size();
        const int seed = row * ranks + world_rank;
        for (int candidate = 0; candidate < n; ++candidate)
            if (seed "'!= candidate) graph.push_back(candidate);
    }
    offsets[rows] = graph.size();
    DeviceBuffer<Point> d_points(n);
    DeviceBuffer<unsigned char> d_active(n);
    DeviceBuffer<Offset> d_offsets(offsets.size());
    DeviceBuffer<int> d_neighbors(graph.size()), d_members(graph.size() + rows), d_counts(rows);
    DeviceBuffer<double> d_maxima(graph.size());
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_points.data, p.data(), n * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_offsets.data, offsets.data(), offsets.size() * sizeof(Offset), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    if (rows) {
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_neighbors.data, graph.data(), graph.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(d_counts.data, 0, rows * sizeof(int)));
    }
    std::vector<unsigned char> active(n, 1);
    std::vector<int> counts(rows), members(graph.size() + rows);
    for (int round = 0; round < 4; ++round) {
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_active.data, active.data(), n, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
        if (rows) {
            buildCandidates<64><<<rows, 64>>>(d_points.data, nullptr, n, threshold,
                world_rank, ranks, false, d_active.data, d_offsets.data, d_neighbors.data,
                d_maxima.data, d_members.data, d_counts.data);
            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
            CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(counts.data(), d_counts.data, rows * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members.data(), d_members.data, members.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
        }
        for (int row = 0; row < rows; ++row) {
            const int seed = row * ranks + world_rank;
            if (!active[seed]) { require(counts[row] == 0, "inactive seed", round); continue; }
            const auto expected = originalCandidate(seed, p, active, threshold);
            require(counts[row] == static_cast<int>(expected.size()), "uncached candidate size", round);
            require(std::equal(expected.begin(), expected.end(), members.begin() + offsets[row] + row), "uncached member order", round);
        }
        Cluster best;
        for (int seed = 0; seed < n; ++seed) {
            if (!active[seed]) continue;
            auto candidate = originalCandidate(seed, p, active, threshold);
            if (candidate.size() > best.members.size()) best = {candidate, seed};
        }
        if (best.members.empty()) break;
        for (int member : best.members) active[member] = 0;
    }
}

+static int world_rank = 0;

+static void mpiCheck(int status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+    fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s: %.*s\n", world_rank, operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+static void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) return;
+    fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s: %s\n", world_rank, operation, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(operation) cudaCheck((operation), #operation)
+#define MPI_CHECK(operation) mpiCheck((operation), #operation)
+
+class MpiRuntime {
+public:
+    MpiRuntime(int& argc, char**& argv) {
+        int provided = 0;
+        if (MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided) != MPI_SUCCESS)
+            std::exit(1);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_set_errhandler(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_ERRORS_RETURN));
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &world_rank));
+        if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED is required.\n");
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+        }
+    }
+    ~MpiRuntime() { MPI_Finalize(); }
+    MpiRuntime(const MpiRuntime&) = delete;
+    MpiRuntime& operator=(const MpiRuntime&) = delete;
+};
+
+template<class T> class DeviceBuffer {
+public:
+    T* data = nullptr;
+    explicit DeviceBuffer(size_t count = 0) { allocate(count); }
+    ~DeviceBuffer() { if (data) cudaFree(data); }
+    DeviceBuffer(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    DeviceBuffer& operator=(const DeviceBuffer&) = delete;
+    void allocate(size_t count) {
+        if (!count) return;
+        if (count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(T)) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: device allocation size overflow\n", world_rank);
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    void tryCache(size_t count) {
+        const cudaError_t status = cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T));
+        if (status == cudaErrorMemoryAllocation) {
+            // The dense cache is optional; clustering still runs entirely on CUDA.
+            data = nullptr;
+            cudaGetLastError();
+        } else {
+            cudaCheck(status, "distance cache allocation");
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+template<class T> class PinnedBuffer {
+public:
+    T* data = nullptr;
+    explicit PinnedBuffer(size_t count) {
+        if (count) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data), count * sizeof(T)));
+    }
+    ~PinnedBuffer() { if (data) cudaFreeHost(data); }
+    PinnedBuffer(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+    PinnedBuffer& operator=(const PinnedBuffer&) = delete;
+};
+

+    ~CudaStream() { cudaStreamDestroy(stream); }
+};

+static int hostThreads(size_t work) {
+    // Avoid creating large CPU teams for tiny GPU result buffers.
+    return static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(omp_get_max_threads(), std::max<size_t>(1, (work + 255) / 256)));
+}

+// Use the same double arithmetic as the FMA-enabled host distance function.
+// In particular, do not compare squared distances: sqrt rounding can create
+// ties, and the sequential algorithm chooses the lowest point index on ties.
+__device__ __forceinline__ double pointDistance(Point a, Point b) {
+    const double dx = a.x - b.x;
+    const double dy = a.y - b.y;
+    return __dsqrt_rn(__fma_rn(dx, dx, __dmul_rn(dy, dy)));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ double cachedDistance(const Point* points,
+                                                const double* distances,
+                                                int n, int a, int b) {
+    return distances ? distances[static_cast<size_t>(a) * n + b]
+                     : pointDistance(points[a], points[b]);
+}

+// Compute each unordered pair once, and store both orientations. The dense
+// cache is bounded by available device memory; sparse rows never depend on it.
+__global__ void buildDistances(const Point* points, double* distances, int n) {
+    if (blockIdx.y > blockIdx.x) return;
+    __shared__ Point column_points[32];
+    __shared__ Point row_points[32];
+    const int column = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * 32 + threadIdx.x;
+    if (threadIdx.y == 0 && column < n) column_points[threadIdx.x] = points[column];
+    const int row_base = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * 32;
+    if (threadIdx.y == 1 && row_base + static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) < n)
+        row_points[threadIdx.x] = points[row_base + threadIdx.x];
+    __syncthreads();
+    for (int r = threadIdx.y; r < 32; r += 8) {
+        const int row = row_base + r;
+        if (column < n && row < n && column >= row) {
+            const double d = pointDistance(column_points[threadIdx.x], row_points[r]);
+            distances[static_cast<size_t>(row) * n + column] = d;
+            distances[static_cast<size_t>(column) * n + row] = d;
         }

-            closest_point = candidate;
+    }

+constexpr int GRAPH_THREADS = 128;
+constexpr int GRAPH_WARPS = GRAPH_THREADS / 32;
+using Offset = unsigned long long;
+
+// Each rank owns cyclic seed rows. A seed can only accept points within its
+// own threshold neighborhood, so this sparse graph is a safe candidate bound.
+__global__ void countNeighbors(const Point* points, int n, double threshold,
+                               int rank, int ranks, int* counts, int* warp_counts) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+    const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * warp / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * (warp + 1) / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    int count = 0;
+    const Point origin = points[seed];
+    for (long long i = static_cast<long long>(begin) + lane; i < end; i += 32)
+        count += i != seed && pointDistance(origin, points[i]) < threshold;
+    for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2)
+        count += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, count, offset);
+    __shared__ int totals[GRAPH_WARPS];
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        totals[warp] = count;
+        warp_counts[static_cast<size_t>(row) * GRAPH_WARPS + warp] = count;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
+        int total = 0;
+        for (int w = 0; w < GRAPH_WARPS; ++w) total += totals[w];
+        counts[row] = total;
+    }
+}
+
+// Warp ballots compact consecutive candidates into sorted CSR rows without
+// atomics. Sorted point indices also coalesce later distance-cache reads.
+__global__ void fillNeighbors(const Point* points, const double* distances,
+                              int n, double threshold, int rank, int ranks,
+                              const Offset* offsets, const int* warp_counts,
+                              int* neighbors) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    if (offsets[row] == offsets[row + 1]) return;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+    const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * warp / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(n) * (warp + 1) / GRAPH_WARPS);
+    Offset position = offsets[row];
+    for (int w = 0; w < warp; ++w)
+        position += warp_counts[static_cast<size_t>(row) * GRAPH_WARPS + w];
+    for (long long base = begin; base < end; base += 32) {
+        const long long candidate = base + lane;
+        const bool eligible = candidate < end && candidate != seed &&
+            cachedDistance(points, distances, n, seed, static_cast<int>(candidate)) < threshold;
+        const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, eligible);
+        if (eligible)
+            neighbors[position + __popc(mask & ((1u << lane) - 1u))] = static_cast<int>(candidate);
+        position += __popc(mask);
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool closer(double d, int point, double best, int best_point) {
+    return d < best || (d == best && point < best_point);
+}
+
+// Each block grows one seed independently. Maintain the maximum distance to
+// the current cluster incrementally: adding one member requires one distance
+// per remaining candidate, rather than rescanning all previous members.
+// A cached cluster remains exact until one of its members is removed: deleting
+// an unchosen candidate cannot change any of the previous greedy decisions.
+template<int THREADS>
+__global__ void buildCandidates(const Point* points, const double* distances,
+                                int n, double threshold, int rank, int ranks,
+                                bool complete_graph, const unsigned char* active,
+                                const Offset* offsets, const int* neighbors,
+                                double* maxima, int* members, int* cardinalities) {
+    const int row = blockIdx.x;
+    const int seed = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(row) * ranks + rank);
+    if (!active[seed] || (complete_graph && seed != 0)) {
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) cardinalities[row] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Offset begin = offsets[row];
+    const Offset end = offsets[row + 1];
+    const Offset member_begin = begin + row;
+    const int previous_size = cardinalities[row];
+    int dirty = previous_size == 0;
+    for (long long i = threadIdx.x; i < previous_size; i += THREADS)
+        dirty |= !active[members[member_begin + i]];
+    if (!__syncthreads_or(dirty)) return;
+
+    for (Offset e = begin + threadIdx.x; e < end; e += THREADS)
+        maxima[e] = active[neighbors[e]] ? 0.0 : DBL_MAX;
+    if (threadIdx.x == 0) members[member_begin] = seed;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    constexpr int WARPS = THREADS / 32;
+    __shared__ double warp_distances[WARPS];
+    __shared__ int warp_points[WARPS];
+    __shared__ int next_point;
+    int last = seed;
+    int size = 1;
+    while (true) {
+        double best_distance = DBL_MAX;
+        int best_point = INT_MAX;
+        const Point last_point = points[last];
+        for (Offset e = begin + threadIdx.x; e < end; e += THREADS) {
+            double maximum = maxima[e];
+            if (!(maximum < threshold) || maximum == DBL_MAX) continue;
+            const int candidate = neighbors[e];
+            if (candidate == last) {
+                maxima[e] = DBL_MAX;
+                continue;
+            }
+            const double d = distances ? distances[static_cast<size_t>(last) * n + candidate]
+                                       : pointDistance(last_point, points[candidate]);
+            maximum = fmax(maximum, d);
+            maxima[e] = maximum;
+            if (maximum < threshold && closer(maximum, candidate, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                best_distance = maximum;
+                best_point = candidate;
+            }
+        }
+        for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2) {
+            const double d = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_distance, offset);
+            const int point = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_point, offset);
+            if (closer(d, point, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                best_distance = d;
+                best_point = point;
+            }
+        }
+        const int lane = threadIdx.x % 32;
+        const int warp = threadIdx.x / 32;
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            warp_distances[warp] = best_distance;
+            warp_points[warp] = best_point;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        if (warp == 0) {
+            best_distance = lane < WARPS ? warp_distances[lane] : DBL_MAX;
+            best_point = lane < WARPS ? warp_points[lane] : INT_MAX;
+            for (int offset = 16; offset; offset /= 2) {
+                const double d = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_distance, offset);
+                const int point = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_point, offset);
+                if (closer(d, point, best_distance, best_point)) {
+                    best_distance = d;
+                    best_point = point;
+                }
+            }
+            if (lane == 0) {
+                next_point = best_point;
+                if (best_point != INT_MAX) members[member_begin + size] = best_point;
+                else cardinalities[row] = size;
+            }
         }
+        __syncthreads();
+        last = next_point;
+        if (last == INT_MAX) break;
+        ++size;
     }
-    
-    return closest_point;
 }

+static std::vector<Offset> rowOffsets(const int* counts, int rows) {
+    std::vector<Offset> offsets(static_cast<size_t>(rows) + 1);
+    const int threads = hostThreads(rows);
+    std::vector<Offset> totals(threads);
+    #pragma omp parallel num_threads(threads)
+    {
+        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();
+        const int team = omp_get_num_threads();
+        const int begin = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(rows) * tid / team);
+        const int end = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(rows) * (tid + 1) / team);
+        Offset sum = 0;
+        for (int row = begin; row < end; ++row) {
+            offsets[row] = sum;
+            sum += counts[row];
+        }
+        totals[tid] = sum;
+        #pragma omp barrier
+        #pragma omp single
+        {
+            Offset prefix = 0;
+            for (int t = 0; t < team; ++t) {
+                const Offset value = totals[t];
+                totals[t] = prefix;
+                prefix += value;
+            }
+            offsets[rows] = prefix;
+        }
+        #pragma omp barrier
+        for (int row = begin; row < end; ++row) offsets[row] += totals[tid];
     }

+static void mpiCheck(int status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(status, message, &length);
+    fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s: %.*s\n", world_rank, operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+static void cudaCheck(cudaError_t status, const char* operation) {
+    if (status == cudaSuccess) return;
+    fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s: %s\n", world_rank, operation, cudaGetErrorString(status));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    std::abort();
+}

+class MpiRuntime {
+public:
+    MpiRuntime(int& argc, char**& argv) {
+        int provided = 0;
+        if (MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided) != MPI_SUCCESS)
+            std::exit(1);
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_set_errhandler(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_ERRORS_RETURN));
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &world_rank));
+        if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED is required.\n");
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+        }
+    }
+    ~MpiRuntime() { MPI_Finalize(); }
+    MpiRuntime(const MpiRuntime&) = delete;
+    MpiRuntime& operator=(const MpiRuntime&) = delete;
+};
